title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION
description: Saturated in hip hop culture comes the birth of a new movement known as “Phantom Live.” Each of the artists have a metal accessory known as “Phantom Metal” which chemically reacts to the wearer’s emotions to produce an image, setting a magnificent stage for enthusiastic youths. With legendary club “CLUB paradox” hosting the mysterious Paradox Live, four teams: BAE, The Cat’s Whiskers, cozmez and Akanyatsura each receive an invitation to participate, each with their own genre of music in a race to the top.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: In the near future, a unique metal known as "phantometal" is used to usher in a new trend into the hip-hop scene. Illusions are manufactured through emotions, making a magnificent display for the "Phantom Lives" sweeping across the world.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: cozmez, a team of twins named Kanata and Nayuta Yatonokami grew up in less-than-ideal circumstances. Living in the slums of society, the brothers make a living to support one another.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Ryu Natsume is a unique member of The Cat’s Whiskers. He doesn’t experience trap reactions when using phantometal and his past is wrapped in mystery. One day, Ryu finds a kitten and brings it home.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: BAE pay a visit to The Cat’s Whiskers dressing room before the battle. Disregarding Allen and Anne’s respect for them, Hajun makes a harsh evaluation, but Ryu’s brief comment sets Hajun into a rage as he leaves the room.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Akanyatsura are a family full of chivalry. Each of them burdened by the trauma of a certain event, they think of each other as a family unrelated by blood.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The first single from when BURAIKAN were independent appears, which catches the attention of many. Elsewhere, Iori and Kanata discuss the dangerous truth about Phantometal.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Shiki is forced to confront his inner demons to remember what happened "that night" with Nayuta.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: In the run-up to BAE's challenge against Akanyatsura, Hajun suffers the consequences of his exposure to the Phantometal. His BAE teammates must enter his mind to save him.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: After saving Hajun, BAE decide to go to a traditional Japanese inn with hot springs in search of tranquility. However, a legend that speaks of the good fortune attracted by a rainbow beetle that inhabits the area will transform this break into a meeting of rappers in search of the beetle.

episodes_data.title: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Allen's past haunts him to the point that a reunion with his father causes him to flee from BAE's battle against cozmez.
